sam: Checked gateway: response code `merchant_declined`, token flagged. Usually one safe retry after customer update. Recommend: 1) email hosted invoice + update CTA now, 2) schedule single retry in 24h if no update, using `force_new_authorization`.

nora: I'll send the outreach: "Hi — we couldn't authorize the card for invoice INV-9987. Please update payment here: <hosted-invoice-link>. If you'd rather wire, reply and we'll send instructions." Short and clear.

billing-bot: System notice: INV-9987 failed (merchant_declined) at 2027-01-12T11:22:09Z. Retry window allowed after 2027-01-13T11:22:09Z.

frank: Finance note: if they request wire quickly, smallest friction is to provide our domestic account. I'll prep the FAQ + copy for CS to attach.

sam: I'll open ticket PAY-8604 and schedule the automated retry for 24h. If retry returns `permanent_decline` we stop attempts and escalate to finance for wire.

lee: Plan confirmed. Nora send message now, Sam schedule retry, Frank ready to send wire details on demand. Update thread when customer replies. :thumbsup:
